properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether initialization should continue when an error occurs when applying a schema script.

properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.isolation-level-for-create
properties.description: Transaction isolation level to use when creating job meta-data for new jobs.

properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.platform
properties.description: Platform to use in initialization scripts if the @@platform@@ placeholder is used. Auto-detected by default.

properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.schema
properties.description: Path to the SQL file to use to initialize the database schema.

properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.table-prefix
properties.description: Table prefix for all the batch meta-data tables.

properties.name: spring.batch.jdbc.validate-transaction-state
properties.description: Whether to validate the transaction state.

properties.name: spring.batch.initializer.enabled
properties.description:
Create the required batch tables on startup if necessary. Enabled automatically
 if no custom table prefix is set or if a custom schema is configured.
